scope: Reconciled generation/native confirmations across generator fixes; not a single frozen full-matrix run, runtime acceptance, live APIs or publication.
notes: Every language contains exactly the same 205 pinned contracts; no exclusions. Successful latest confirmations replace earlier cases.
Swift retains successful cases from an iterative 150-case prefix. All its failures have frozen follow-ups, plus latest representative confirmations.
Rust Zuora and Swift Azure Compute retries resolve runner EOF interruptions during a shell script edit; these were incomplete checks.
Byte budgets are warning/chunk targets; atomic declarations can exceed them. Peak memory was not measured.
Final idempotency argument fixes have focused native regressions; this corpus predominantly has no auto-idempotency annotations.
